vulnerability_title: [M-16] Force exercise lacks caller-side bounds for exercise fee

recommendation.recommendation_text: Consider adding explicit caller-side bounds for force exercise payments.

poc.poc_text:

```

 "import {PositionBalance, PositionBalanceLibrary} from "@types/PositionBalance.sol";"
```
